vya_text: dI0 - atha himakalpanAM nidarSayannAha - kShuNNamiti | ayaM himakaShAyo~anayA pariBAShayA prathito Bavati | kathaM ? yathA ``kShuNNaM samyakkuTTitaM ShaDBirnIrapalaiH'' iti dravyaparimANAt | niSoShitamiti sakalaniSAyAmadhyuShitaM, tena prAtaH saMsrAvya dravaM grAhyamityarthaH | etasya paryAyanAmnA SItakaShAyaH kathitaH | taduktaM tantrAntare - ``SIto rAtriM drave sthitaH'' iti | tanmAnaM tu PANTavajj~jeyamiti tasya parimANaM pAnArthaM PANTavajj~jAtam | mAnagrahaNenApi prakShepAdayo~api PANTavajj~jAtavyAH | eSha niScayaH sarvatraiva nAnyat || 1 ||
gU0 - himakalpanA | kShuNNaM kuTTitaM dravyapalaiH ShaDBirnIrapalaiH plutaM niSoShitaM rAtristhApitaM himaH syAt tanmAnaM BakShaNamAnaM PANTavaddvipalam || 1||

pada: caturtho~adhyAyaH | kShuNNaM dravyapalaM samyakShaDBirnIrapalaiH plutam | niSoShitaM himaH sa syAttathA SItakaShAyakaH ||1|| tanmAnaM PANTavajj~jeyaM sarvatraivaiSha niScayaH |
